text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Mr. C.B. claiming victory in the 
Satsuki Sho, the public anticipated the 
honor of a Classic Triple Crown. Yet she 
herself had no interest in the title.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer advises her to run freely. Mr. 
C.B. laughs and declares that she'll run 
however she likes, true to herself.
